messages:
caller_jason: Hey @support — customer reported promo credits not decrementing after a resumed embeddings stream. They got a 200 on the final chunk but the wallet balance stayed the same in the dashboard. request_id=req_9f3b, org=acme-io. Repro steps attached below.

maria_billing: Thanks Jason — can you confirm whether the client retried the websocket after a dropped connection, or if they used a new session? Also need the ledger_tx_id if available.

caller_jason: They had a dropped ws, reconnected and re-sent the remaining chunks with the same client-side upload id. No ledger_tx_id visible in their app logs. Example sequence: connect -> send 3 chunks -> ws disconnect -> reconnect -> send 2 chunks -> server 200. UI balance unchanged.

ryan_support: Got it. Can you paste the exact curl equivalent they used (or the SDK usage)? Also include timestamps for the two sessions so we can correlate in the logs.

caller_jason: Paste of simplified repro (they used node ws lib but below is REST equivalent we used to simulate):

```
# pseudo: send first batch
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: upload-acme-42" \
  -d '{"inputs": ["a","b","c"]}'
# simulate disconnect, then retry remaining
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: upload-acme-42" \
  -d '{"inputs": ["d","e"]}'
```

Requests both returned 200 and produced embeddings. UI still shows the same promo credit balance before/after. Timestamps: 2024-03-03T14:12:01Z and 2024-03-03T14:12:47Z.

maria_billing: Thanks — assigning to eng to check ledger events. @violet_eng can you look for ledger entries for org=acme-io around those timestamps and check if finalize/finalize_webhook events were received? Also check if the idempotency-key was honored or if we treated the resumed stream as a new session.

violet_eng: On it. Initial quick scan: I see two embed request rows (req_9f3b and req_9f3b-retry) separated by 40s, both produced output tokens. Only the first created a ledger 'pending' entry; the second appears to have been fast-path deduped at the ingestion layer and did not generate a finalize event. Looks like a race between our streaming finalize webhook and the retry path — the ledger never transitioned to 'consumed'.

violet_eng: Hypothesis: when a resumed stream is processed with the same Idempotency-Key we short-circuit and return success without re-emitting finalize hooks. This caused promo credits to never be decremented for that session.

ryan_support: Can we confirm whether the promo engine only decrements on finalize webhook? If so that's the root cause.

maria_billing: Yes promo consumption runs off the finalized ledger transition. If finalize is missing, credits don't decrement.

violet_eng: Repro steps I used in staging: 1) start ws upload with Idempotency-Key X and send partial payload; 2) inject connection drop; 3) resend remaining payload with same key; 4) observe server returns 200 but ledger stays in 'pending' because finalize path skipped. I have a minimal repro script.

violet_eng: Proposed quick fix: ensure retry path emits the same finalize event or make promo-charge idempotent on token-usage rows (double-check ledger transitions). I'll open a patch to emit finalize for fast-path dedupe.

maria_billing: Sounds good. Also need a short-term customer-facing remediation: we can manually force-finalize their pending ledger entry and apply the promo debit. If you provide ledger id I can reconcile.

caller_jason: Customer can't see ledger id. I have their org id acme-io and timestamps. Please let me know what you need. They are on a promo grant and want the UI to show decrementing credits for trust.

violet_eng: I found ledger row id LDR-77421 in staging-equivalent logs that maps to the first req. It is stuck in 'pending'. I'll run a DB migration to emit finalize hook for pending rows older than 30s as a temporary safety. After that we should see billing-bot report a debit.

billing-bot: [automated] Debit applied: ledger=LDR-77421 amount= -1500 units. Promo balance for org acme-io now 4500 units.

maria_billing: Follow-up: we'll backfill monitoring to alert on pending ledger entries > 60s and add a test for resumed-stream idempotency in the embed e2e suite. Violet, please link the PR with the rollback plan.

violet_eng: Will do — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 (hotfix: emit finalize on deduped-retry). Deploying to prod in the next patch window.

ryan_support: Thanks team. Jason, I'll update the customer: explained root cause and that we forced finalize; they should see their promo balance change in 5min. If it doesn't, ping me and I'll escalate to billing ops. :thumbsup:
